markets_note: A mixed day: the S&P 500 fell about 1.0 percent and the Nasdaq fell about 2.6 percent, while the Dow gained about 1.3 percent. The 10 year Treasury yield eased to 4.95 percent and the VIX was near 19.

items.title: An Elite Marathoner Blamed a Prescription for Her Positive Doping Test. The Problem? The ‘Doctor’ Who Wrote It Wasn’t a Doctor.
items.summary: Runner's World reports that elite marathoner Ruti Aga, a podium finisher at six World Marathon Majors and the 2019 Tokyo Marathon winner, blamed a prescription for her positive doping test. The headline says the person who wrote the prescription was not a doctor. The excerpt does not give the outcome of her case.

items.summary: iRunFar reports that Belgian runners Merijn Geerts and Ivo Steyaert finished together to break the backyard ultra record for a third time. The excerpt does not give the new distance.
